ask: Why is it on the path?
cards: A third to half of Europe dead in seven years, and the medieval order with them.
The conqueror that travelled with the conquistadors and did most of their work.
Justinian's plague arrived at the empire's height and helped bury his reconquest of the West.
An empire of millions brought down as much by epidemics as by Spanish steel.
The war whose ending coincided with the deadliest influenza in history.
